en: Vintage sepia postcard with two inset photographs framed by light floral/berry illustrations. The left image shows a small historic church with a tall, simple tower, pitched roof, stone wall and trees in front. The right image shows a broad village square or main street lined with low plastered buildings, a few carts and people. Red printed text in German appears between and below the images, and a small red manuscript number is written in the upper right corner. A publisher's line is printed in red at the bottom.
